entry_points.summary: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 for handoff.json. protocol_version enum ['1.0','1.1']; required: protocol_version, timestamp, agent, status, next_step, context_files; optional: slug (string|null), attend_resume (1.1 only). context_files minItems:1, items {path, role enum [spec|plan|tasks|workstreams|session_log|diff|other]}. attend_resume sub-object required fields: expected_head_sha, expected_phase, done_set_hash, dirty_state_fingerprint, session_id — all minLength:1.

Agent-facing slash command. 5 phases: (0) resolve run context from Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR/RUN; (1) detect context — 1a slug/plan, 1b context_files priority order (plan artifacts > workstreams > session log > active diff > explicit > fallback), 1c next_step (ARGUMENTS override > TASKS.md first-pending > FIX.md approach > ad-hoc), 1d status (context_pressure|clean_break|complete|blocked — default clean_break), 1e agent id; (2) assemble/validate — context_files non-empty, next_step non-empty unless complete; (3) atomic write to $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR/handoff.json (fallback to $PWD when slug null); (4) handoff_written telemetry; (5) exit with summary.

Automated producer. Required env: Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR. Optional: Z_HARNESS_SLUG, Z_HARNESS_AGENT (default 'pi'), Z_HARNESS_MODEL, Z_HARNESS_CONTEXT_PCT. Status always 'clean_break'. Reads TASKS.md for task counts; reads SESSION.md YAML frontmatter (done_count, next_pending) and body sections (Decisions, Landmines, Open threads) to compose next_step. context_files: SPEC.md, PLAN.md, TASKS.md, SESSION.md (whichever exist). Protocol branch: Z_HARNESS_ATTEND_RESUME=0/absent → 1.0 (no attend_resume); Z_HARNESS_ATTEND_RESUME=1 → 1.1 with 5 required attend env vars (ATTEND_HEAD_SHA, ATTEND_PHASE, ATTEND_DONE_SET_HASH, ATTEND_DIRTY_FP, ATTEND_SESSION_ID); any missing var → exit 1 naming them. Atomic tmp+rename write. Stdout: 'STATUS: written bytes=<n>'.

Protocol narrative: status enum definitions (context_pressure, clean_break, complete, blocked), context_files role enum, consumer contract (detect→validate→load-in-order→pass-next_step→delete), slug-present optimization (set Z_HARNESS_SLUG + Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR), pre-existing handoff.json overwrite rule, examples for 4 status values.

invariants: handoff.json is always written to $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR when in a plan; workspace root is the plan-less fallback only (slug null).
protocol_version '1.0' never includes attend_resume; protocol_version '1.1' always includes attend_resume with all 5 sub-fields non-empty.

All 5 attend env vars (ATTEND_HEAD_SHA, ATTEND_PHASE, ATTEND_DONE_SET_HASH, ATTEND_DIRTY_FP, ATTEND_SESSION_ID) must be non-empty before write-handoff.sh emits a 1.1 handoff; any missing var causes an immediate exit 1.
The agent field is provenance only — consumers MUST NOT branch behavior on it.
context_files must have at least 1 entry; minItems:1 enforced by schema.
next_step must be non-empty unless status is 'complete'; capped at 2000 chars.
Atomic write always: write to .tmp.<PID> in the same directory then rename; consumer never sees a partial handoff.json.
write-handoff.sh at the /z-implement-all compaction breakpoint is gated by workflow.hermes_enabled=true; /z-attend calls it unconditionally at yield boundaries.
A pre-existing handoff.json is overwritten by the producer; the consumer (Hermes or /z-attend) must read and delete before a new one is written.
gotchas: write-handoff.sh exits non-zero if Z_HARNESS_ATTEND_RESUME=1 but any of the 5 attend vars is empty; /z-attend must set all 5 before calling the script or the yield will fail loudly.
handoff.json path is $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR — NOT repo root or cwd. Orchestrators reading from the wrong path silently miss the file.
hermes_enabled=false (default) suppresses write-handoff.sh at the /z-implement-all compaction breakpoint. No handoff.json is written for Hermes consumption unless the knob is on.
An unconsumed handoff.json is silently overwritten by the next producer invocation; the prior session's resume data is lost without any warning.
status is always 'clean_break' in write-handoff.sh regardless of actual context state — the context_pressure status is only set by the /z-handoff slash command.
